in_hebrew.name: פֶלָא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'pelah', meaning 'to break through' or 'to roll up'. The name Fela can be interpreted as 'wondrous', 'strange', or 'marvelous'.

in_greek.name: Φέλα
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'phos' meaning 'light' or 'bright', and the suffix 'ela' meaning 'shining' or 'clear'. The name Fela can be interpreted as 'bright' or 'shining'.

in_latin.name: Fela
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Fela does not have a direct translation in Latin, but it may have been adopted from the Greek 'Φέλα' (Phéla) or the Hebrew 'פֶלָא (pela)'. The name Fela can be interpreted as 'bright' or 'shining'.
